description.fun: In a swarm, Volbeat glow their round tails to signal to each other and draw geometric patterns across the sky. They're drawn in by the sweet scent of Illumise, which directs the display. Every Volbeat is male and every Illumise female, and its look may borrow from 1950s greasers, collar and all. If its pond gets dirty, it simply moves house.
description.guide: A Bug-type Pokémon based on a firefly, and always male; Illumise is its female counterpart, and Ditto can hatch Eggs of either. It lives in forests near clean ponds. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: A firefly whose glowing tail draws patterns in the sky
